{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float after removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of internal test orders: {len(test_orders)}')

# Filter out internal test orders and refunded orders
df_filtered = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]
print(f'Number of completed orders (excluding test orders): {len(df_filtered)}')

# Calculate total revenue
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}')

# Output the final value
total_revenue"}
